78915-there-is-confusion.title: There Is Confusion
78915-there-is-confusion.creator: Unknown
78915-there-is-confusion.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He stared at her amazed and adoring. She was like a little, living echo out of his own forgotten past. Joel Marshall, born a slave and the son of a slave in Richmond, Virginia, had felt as a little boy that same impulse to greatness.

arxiv-2004-01251.title: R 3 R^{3} : A Reading Comprehension Benchmark Requiring Reasoning Processes*
arxiv-2004-01251.creator: Ran Wang, Kun Tao, Dingjie Song, Zhilong Zhang, Xiao Ma, Xi’ao Su, Xinyu Dai
arxiv-2004-01251.description: Abstract Existing question answering systems can only predict answers without explicit reasoning processes, which hinder their explainability and make us overestimate their ability of understanding and reasoning over natural language. In this work, we propose a novel task of reading comprehension, in which a model is required to provide final answers and reasoning processes.

arxiv-2005-11862.title: Climbing down Charney’s ladder: Machine Learning and the post-Dennard era of computational climate science Journal: rsta
arxiv-2005-11862.creator: V. Balaji 1
arxiv-2005-11862.description: Abstract The advent of digital computing in the 1950s sparked a revolution in the science of weather and climate. Meteorology, long based on extrapolating patterns in space and time, gave way to computational methods in a decade of advances in numerical weather forecasting.

arxiv-2204-01385.title: Aligned Weight Regularizers for Pruning Pretrained Neural Networks
arxiv-2204-01385.creator: James O’ Neill, Sourav Dutta, Haytham Assem
arxiv-2204-01385.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by James O’ Neill, Sourav Dutta, Haytham Assem. While various avenues of research have been explored for iterative pruning, little is known what effect pruning has on zero-shot test performance and its potential implications on the choice of pruning criteria. This pruning setup is particularly important for cross-lingual models that implicitly learn alignment between language representations during pretraining, which if distorted via pruning, not only leads to poorer performance on language data used for retraining but also on zero-shot languages that are evaluated.

arxiv-2303-04933.title: The B B & V V Light Curves for Recurrent Nova T CrB From 1842–2022, the Unique Pre- and Post-Eruption High-States, the Complex Period Changes, and the Upcoming Eruption in 2025.5 ± \pm 1.3 2021 The B B & V V Light Curves for Recurrent Nova T CrB From 1842–2022, the Unique Pre- and Post-Eruption High
arxiv-2303-04933.creator: Bradley E. Schaefer
arxiv-2303-04933.description: Abstract T CrB is one of the most-famous and brightest novae known, and is a recurrent nova with prior eruptions in 1866 and 1946 that peak at V V =2.0. I have constructed light curves spanning 1842–2022 with 213,730 magnitudes, where the B B and V V magnitudes are fully corrected to the Johnson system.

arxiv-2303-10547.title: Event-triggered privacy preserving consensus control with edge-based additive noise
arxiv-2303-10547.creator: Limei Liang, Ruiqi Ding, Shuai Liu
arxiv-2303-10547.description: Abstract In this article, we investigate the distributed privacy preserving weighted consensus control problem for linear continuous-time multi-agent systems under the event-triggering communication mode. A novel event-triggered privacy preserving consensus scheme is proposed, which can be divided into three phases.

arxiv-2406-02630.title: AI Agents Under Threat: A Survey of Key Security Challenges and Future Pathways
arxiv-2406-02630.creator: Zehang Deng, Yongjian Guo, Changzhou Han, Wanlun Ma, Junwu Xiong, Sheng Wen, Yang Xiang
arxiv-2406-02630.description: Abstract . An Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent is a software entity that autonomously performs tasks or makes decisions based on pre-defined objectives and data inputs. AI agents, capable of perceiving user inputs, reasoning and planning tasks, and executing actions, have seen remarkable advancements in algorithm development and task performance. However, the security challenges they pose remain under-explored and unresolved.

arxiv-2412-10685.title: RMCSA Algorithm for Congestion-Aware and Service Latency Aware Dynamic Service Provisioning in Software-Defined SDM-EONs
arxiv-2412-10685.creator: Baljinder Singh Heera, Shrinivas Petale, Yatindra Nath Singh, Suresh Subramaniam
arxiv-2412-10685.description: Abstract The implementation of 5G and the future deployment of 6G necessitate the utilization of optical networks that possess substantial capacity and exhibit minimal latency. The dynamic arrival and departure of connection requests in optical networks result in particular central links experiencing more traffic and congestion than non-central links.

pmc-10669581.title: The Diagnostic, Therapeutic and Prognostic Relevance of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps in Polytrauma
pmc-10669581.creator: Emily Rogers, Shevani Pothugunta, Veronika Kosmider, Natasha Stokes, Layla Bonomini, Gabrielle D Briggs, Daniel P Lewis, Zsolt J Balogh, Peter Celec
pmc-10669581.description: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) represent a recently discovered polymorphonuclear leukocyte-associated ancient defence mechanism, and they have also been identified as part of polytrauma patients’ sterile inflammatory response. This systematic review aimed to determine the clinical significance of NETs in polytrauma, focusing on potential prognostic, diagnostic and therapeutic relevance.

pmc-11368683.title: An in vitro model of acute horizontal basal cell activation reveals gene regulatory networks underlying the nascent activation phase
pmc-11368683.creator: Camila M. Barrios-Camacho, Matthew J. Zunitch, Jonathan D. Louie, Woochan Jang, James E. Schwob
pmc-11368683.description: SummaryWhile horizontal basal cells (HBCs) make minor contributions to olfactory epithelium (OE) regeneration during homeostatic conditions, they possess a potent, latent capacity to activate and subsequently regenerate the OE following severe injury. Activation requires, and is mediated by, the downregulation of the transcription factor (TF) TP63.

pmc-11393740.title: Development of a nanocomposite hydrogel catalyzed H2O2/TMB system for determination of chlordiazepoxide in exhaled breath condensate
pmc-11393740.creator: Yasaman Sefid-Sefidehkhan, Zahra Karimzadeh, Abolghasem Jouyban, Maryam Khoubnasabjafari, Vahid Jouyban-Gharamaleki, Elaheh Rahimpour
pmc-11393740.description: In this study, an enzyme mimic catalyzed H2O2–tetramethylbenzidine system based on UiO-66/Au NPs–PVA nanocomposite hydrogel was employed as an optical probe for chlordiazepoxide sensing. An excellent detection limit of 0.0032 μg mL−1 with a linear range of 0.005–2.0 μg mL−1 was obtained for chlordiazepoxide in exhaled breath condensate samples under optimal conditions.

pmc-11624231.title: Long-term tumor control following repeat gamma-knife radiosurgery of growing pituitary adenomas: a population-based cohort study
pmc-11624231.creator: Felicia Lindberg, Alexander Gabri, Helena Kristiansson, Michael Gubanski, Charlotte Höybye, Martin Olsson, Petter Förander, Simon Skyrman, Bodo Lippitz, Alexander Fletcher-Sandersjöö, Jiri Bartek
pmc-11624231.description: BackgroundGamma Knife radiosurgery (GKRS) is a well-established treatment for residual or growing pituitary adenomas (PAs) post-partial resection. However, some PAs grow even after initial GKRS, for which the efficacy of repeat GKRS is unclear. The primary objective of this study was to determine long-term progression-free survival (PFS) following repeated GKRS in patients with PA.

pmc-13071329.title: A Pangenome Framework Reveals Conserved Pathogenicity‐Associated Biosynthetic Gene Clusters in Fusarium equiseti, a Root Rot Pathogen of Panax notoginseng
pmc-13071329.creator: Xuping Zhang, Xiang Li, Xiaojun Li, Chao Peng, Weiguang Wang
pmc-13071329.description: Panax notoginseng (Chinese ginseng, sanqi) is an economically and medicinally important herb whose cultivation is increasingly threatened by destructive soilborne root rot. Although Fusarium species represent the dominant pathogens in this disease complex, the virulence determinants underlying Fusarium–P. notoginseng interactions remain largely unknown, particularly the contribution of secondary metabolite (SM) biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) in medicinal plants.

pmc-13079967.title: A Cross‐Sectional Study on the Role of Biochemical Markers in Cardiovascular Disease Risk Assessment: Comparison of Urban and Rural Populations in Pakistan
pmc-13079967.creator: Mukesh Kumar, Sangeeta Davi, Ashvin Kumar, Zainab Muhammad Hanif, F N U Ghansham, Chandni Bai, Sagar Kumar, Jugdesh Kumar, Manesh Kumar, Mohsin Zaheer, F N U Venjhraj, Amogh Verma
pmc-13079967.description: Background and AimsCardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of mortality worldwide, with a growing prevalence in developing countries such as Pakistan due to urbanization and lifestyle changes. This study aimed to compare biochemical markers and associated cardiovascular risk factors between urban and rural populations in Pakistan.

pmc-13226118.title: Empowering coaching in youth basketball: the balancing mechanism between coaching authority and athlete autonomy
pmc-13226118.creator: Junmin Zhang, Yongfeng Liu, Xiaogang Zhang, Ruobing Chen, Guang Feng, Shuiyou Hu
pmc-13226118.description: ObjectiveIn training practices, ingrained power dynamics between coaches and athletes often hinder the adoption of an “athlete-centered” approach, leading to diminished efficiency in sports training. Consequently, academia calls for scholars to reflect on coach-athlete power relations and explore coaching approaches aligned with athletes’ needs.

pmc-13254519.title: Genomic epidemiology of dengue virus serotype 3 lineage 3III_B.3.2 in Brazil: insights into its spread and dengue severity amid co-circulation of multiple dengue serotypes
pmc-13254519.creator: Caroline do Nascimento Ferreira, Carla Adriane Royer, Camila Confortin, Nelson Fernando Quallio Marques, Mayra Marinho Presibella, Aline Andrade Freund, Karoline Rodrigues Campos, Claudio Tavares Sacchi, Adriano Abbud, Gustavo Barbosa de Lima, Clarice Neuenschwander Lins de Morais, Veronica Gomes da
pmc-13254519.description: SummaryBackgroundAfter over a decade of minimal circulation, DENV-3 reemerged in Brazil in 2023, driven by the newly detected lineage 3III_B.3.2. Elucidating the patterns of DENV-3 spread and impact on public health, is critically important in the context of Brazil’s hyperendemic dengue scenario. Here, we aimed to investigate the spatiotemporal dispersion of this new lineage and its epidemiological impact in Brazil.

pmc-13353782.title: POU2F2 as a dual oncogenic and immunomodulatory driver in kidney renal clear cell carcinoma
pmc-13353782.creator: Gonglin Tang, Fei Liu, Mingze Sun, Chenyue Liu, Jitao Wu, Hongwei Zhao
pmc-13353782.description: Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) features an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). We investigated the role of transcription factor POU2F2 in KIRC oncogenesis and macrophage polarization. Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics showed that POU2F2 is upregulated in KIRC and associated with metastasis and poor prognosis. POU2F2 knockdown inhibited KIRC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro.

pmc-13507532.title: Dietary sunflower hulls and protein levels affect performance, gut health, and litter quality in broiler chickens
pmc-13507532.creator: N Beigzadeh, S Salari, F Zaefarian, Sh Hosseinifar
pmc-13507532.description: This study evaluated the effects of different dietary levels of sunflower hulls (SFH) as an insoluble fiber source on growth performance, nutrient digestibility, intestinal morphology, cecal microbial populations, litter quality, and digesta transit time in broiler chickens fed varying levels of crude protein (CP).
